# Security

Please do **not** open a public issue for a vulnerability in PolyglotScan.

Email the maintainers via the GitHub org profile, or open a **private** security advisory on this repository.

We treat unofficial store listings that impersonate PolyglotScan (ads, malware, fake subscriptions) as Brand Guardian License Prohibited Distribution, trademark, and consumer-safety problems — see [TRADEMARK.adoc](../TRADEMARK.adoc). Report those the same way.
